column3: “Punish” expresses the sense of visiting their iniquities upon them.
“Where to go” is supplied to the agreement.
“Bait” interprets the snare; “has nothing to catch” replaces “does not catch anything.”
“Strongholds” interprets “your strength”; the passive plundering clause becomes active.
“Having just” is supplied; “cushion” interprets the final couch expression, and “or” replaces “and.”
“Destruction” makes the sense of visiting the altars explicit.
“Great” interprets a word that can also mean “many.”
